## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses. Also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and pure TypeScript guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit and integration tests pass locally (`npm test`).
- [ ] TypeScript type checks pass with zero errors (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation where appropriate.
